description:
The Avare aviation GPS app is open on the main map screen with the default Sectional chart type selected. Your task:
1. Tap the 'Menu' button at the bottom-left of the screen.
2. On the right side of the menu overlay, you will see 'Sectional' indicating the current chart type. Tap on 'Sectional'.
3. A chart type selection list will appear showing options: Sectional, TAC, WAC, IFR Low, IFR High, IFR Area, Terrain, etc.
4. Select 'IFR Low' from the list by tapping the radio button next to it.
5. Verify the chart type has changed from 'Sectional' to 'IFR Low' by checking that the menu now shows 'IFR Low' instead of 'Sectional'.
